target_customer: Developers and companies building AI notetakers and conversation intelligence products
problem: Capturing audio, video and transcripts from Zoom, Meet and Teams requires a year or more of in house integration work.
business_model: Usage based API priced per hour of recording
product_category: Meeting bot and recording API infrastructure

founders.name: David Gu
education: University of Waterloo, software engineering, dropped out

founders.name: Amanda Zhu
education: University of Waterloo, computer science and business, dropped out

technical_complexity.rationale: Joining and recording across Zoom, Meet, Teams and Webex with per participant streams at scale.

defensibility.rationale: Many customers embed the API (3,000 plus per its site) but meeting platforms control access; copycats now exist (Attendee, Meeting BaaS, Skribby per its comparison pages).

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Zoom later worked with Recall.ai as a preferred partner rather than replacing it (secondary sources).

market_need_then: Remote work and generative AI created demand for meeting data, and building bots in house took a year or more (TechCrunch 2024).

branding.domain_note: Uses recall.ai, an AI top level domain; not a .com.

brand_strength.rationale: Known among developers building meeting AI, but no sourced brand press or community; the name collides with other products called Recall.

pivots.from: Real time transcription tool for video conferences (YC W20 era)
pivots.to: Universal meeting bot API for developers
pivots.why: Founders launched Recall.ai in 2022 after seeing others struggle with the same integration problem (TechCrunch 2024).

outcome_analysis: Recall.ai started in the W20 batch with a transcription tool and relaunched in 2022 as a meeting bot API as generative AI created demand for meeting data. Revenue reportedly grew from zero to several million dollars in under two years, it raised a 10 million Series A in May 2024 and a 38 million Series B in September 2025. Dependence on Zoom and Microsoft access is the key risk.
notes: YC page says founded 2022 but batch Winter 2020. Series B valuation of 250M is reported by secondary outlets and it is unclear if post money, so not recorded. Seed amount, date (post of 2022-12-29) and investors come from the company's seed post. Competitor search found nothing dated near 2020; the CEO says there were no direct competitors (2024), so list empty.
